name: Ryoujoku Toujou - Maketara Ryoujoku Namachuukei! Hamerareta JK Kakutouka
original_name: 凌辱闘場 負けたら凌辱生中継! ハメられたJK格闘家
source:
Rinko, a JK at the local highschool, is a real strong karate girl.
She won the national karate contest this year and is now looking for a new challenge.
One day, one of the members in her club gives her a flier with information about an underground martial arts tournament and she is totally interested!

...It would seem however, that she bit off more than she could chew...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196088.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
凛子是当地高中的女高中生，也是一名实力强劲的空手道少女。
她今年赢得了全国空手道大赛冠军，现在正寻找新的挑战。
一天，社团中的一名成员递给她一张传单，上面介绍了一场地下格斗大赛，她立刻产生了兴趣！

……然而，看起来她似乎高估了自己的能力……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE196088.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
